name: IRC_COMM_ACCOUNTS
description: Stores all the accounts of the communication providers.

columns.name: COMM_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table. System generated.

columns.name: FOOTER_TEXT_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: To enable or disable footer text in an outbound SMS message

columns.name: FOOTER_TEXT
columns.description: Footer text in an oubound SMS message

columns.name: ACCOUNT_GUID
columns.description: Application generated GUID of the provider account.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the communication provider account.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for the communication provider account.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CONFIG
columns.description: Communication provider account  configuration information  including credentials of the account.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the communication provider account.The corresponding lookup type is IRC_COMM_ACCOUNT_STATUS_TYPE.

columns.name: MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH
columns.description: Max length for a message set by provider.

columns.name: DELETE_MSG_ON_READ_FLAG
columns.description: Determine whether the messages for this account should be delete after they are read.

columns.name: ENABLE_TWO_WAY_COMM_FLAG
columns.description: Determine whether the messages for this account supports 2 way sms communication

columns.name: COMM_ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the communication provider account.Determine whether account provider is Recruiting provider or Communicate provider.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
